plugin.description: Shows the battery level of a device - laptop, mouse, keyboard, headset - on a key.
plugin.requirements: UPower running on the system, which is the case on most desktop Linux installations.

BatteryPercentage.description: Shows the charge level of one battery on the key, with a battery icon and the percentage below it. It updates itself and needs no press. The background turns red below 25% and green above 90%.

device.description: Which battery to show, by the device's model name as UPower reports it. Without it the key shows "off".
